claim_checks.claim: Price-led growth with negative volume (2024: price 7.0%, volume -3.0%)
claim_checks.finding: Confirmed price-led and minor numeric correction: FY24 core price 7.1%, volume -2.9% (total internal 4.2%). Volume negative every year since 2022: -1.1% (22), -2.0% (23), -2.9% (24), -2.8% (25), -1.5% (9M-26). Core price decelerating from 9.5% (23) to 5.7% (9M-26); yield 4.5% 9M-26.

claim_checks.claim: Thesis breaker: solid waste core price <4.5%
claim_checks.finding: Core price 5.7% 9M-26 (5.5% Q3) - above threshold but note company now also reports 'yield' 4.5% (9M) / 4.3% (Q3), already at/below 4.5%. Clarify which metric the breaker uses.

Organic slowed from 9.3% (21) to 2.0% (25) - FY25 depressed by -0.8pt closed operation and -2.8% volume; 9M-26 recovered to 3.8%. Organic growth ex-acquisitions is materially below the headline ~6-11% revenue growth.
